The name Seraphinus is also associated with the virtue of courage and the ability to withstand trials and temptations. In modern times, the name Seraphinus is used to represent a child who is born with a fiery or passionate spirit, and is seen as a unique and special individual. He was known for his extraordinary ascetic feats and miraculous powers, and was revered by the local population.

Saint Seraphinus of Valtice, also known as Seraphim of Valtice, was a Bohemian priest who lived during the late 13th and early 14th centuries. He was renowned for his piety and was known to have performed many miracles. He was canonized by the Roman Catholic Church in 1623.
